newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian petrochem sector seen growing at 12-15 pct.
newsitem.headline: Indian petrochem sector seen growing at 12-15 pct.

text.p: The Indian petrochemical sector will continue to grow at an average 12-15 percent annually in the next few years, a top government official said on Wednesday.

"The average annual growth in production and consumption has been 12 to 15 percent," N.R. Banerji, Secretary of the Department of Chemicals and Petrochemicals in the federal government said in a speech delivered at a chemicals marketing conference.

"From the current consumption levels of 1.5 million tonnes and 0.7 million tonnes, polymers and fibres are expected to reach a demand level of 2.8 million tonnes and 1.1 million tonnes respectively," Banerji said.
Analysts said Indian petrochemicals sector was growing at an above world average because of a low consumption base and rapid industrialisation.
India, long dependent on petrochemical imports, has seen large new investments in this sector in recent years.
